notes.title: Development Progress
notes.content:
[p]Thank you all so much for playing the Tenebris Legion demo and sharing your ideas and feedback! I promise every comment is carefully considered and implemented when it fits the game’s vision.

I’m working tirelessly as a solo dev to finish the game as soon as possible, though as you can imagine, it’s no small task. The gameplay is coming along nicely, and I’m now focused on tying everything together, replacing placeholder dialogue with final versions, and polishing the art to create a game I’m truly proud of.

As you know, I’m aiming to put a fresh spin on the adult VN genre by adding deeper gameplay with classic adventure game mechanics. While my original plan was to release by October, I might need to push the date a bit to avoid rushing and ensure a polished game. I’m still working on timelines and will keep you posted.

Huge thanks for your support and wishlists! You make this journey worthwhile.[/p]

notes.title: Tenebris Legion Demo Now Available on Steam!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! After countless hours of hard work, I'm thrilled to announce that the [b]Tenebris Legion demo is finally here[/b]![/p][p]The demo gives you a taste of what's to come, covering the events of Day 1. You'll meet Laura, one of the main characters, experience the game through Ethan's eyes, and get a feel for the navigation system and overall gameplay. While this isn't representative of the final quality (I'm constantly improving things!), it should give you a solid preview of where the game is headed.[/p][p][b]Quick heads up:[/b] Save systems and achievements aren't available in the demo, but they'll be fully implemented in the final release.[/p][p][b]Mac users:[/b] I haven't forgotten about you! I'm working on getting the Mac version ready and hope to release it in the coming weeks. Thanks for your patience![/p][p]I genuinely hope you enjoy this sneak peek at what's coming. If you have any feedback that could make the game better, please share it with me! Your input is invaluable as I continue development.[/p][p]For those who played Pleasure Thieves, you'll notice Tenebris Legion is a significant step up both technically and narratively. As a solo developer, I know I can't match what full teams can produce, but I'm determined to create something special that leaves you satisfied when the credits roll.[/p][p]Thank you so much for your interest and support. Can't wait to hear what you think![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3737630/Tenebris_Legion_Demo/?beta=1"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Happy gaming![/p]

notes.title: Game Update: Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444131/f77cee1f89ed9e0a405b3a9e7585720122113b60.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

First of all, I want to express my deepest gratitude for your interest in my game. Your support provides tremendous motivation to continue with the development.

I'm excited to announce that very soon, I'll be releasing [b]a playable demo[/b]! This will give you the opportunity to try the game and share your opinions while I work on completing the full version. The game is actually quite far along in development, and I've spent these last few months polishing the demo to ensure it represents the quality I aim to achieve in the final product.

Since I'm still working on the game, your feedback will be invaluable in helping me implement improvements I might have overlooked. I encourage you to suggest enhancements for the game, always with respect, of course.

In future updates, I'll be sharing more about the game's overall story and characters, so stay tuned for that!

I hope that with your comments and suggestions, we can create a game we can all be proud of.

Thank you very much!
